Introduction

EVERGLOW (stylized as ΣVΣRGLOW) is a four-member girl group formed by Yuehua Entertainment. Originally as six, they debuted on March 18, 2019, with the release of their first digital single "Arrival of Everglow", and its title track "Bon Bon Chocolat".

The group name can be translated to “Always glowing” and thus reflects on the group’s strong will, energy, and potential. The fandom name can be split up into two parts, being "For" and "Ever", or "For EVERGLOW", meaning the fans are devoted to the members, and "forever", meaning to become one with EVERGLOW and to be together forever.

Prior to their debut in EVERGLOW, Sihyeon appeared as a contestant on Mnet's survival shows Produce 101 and Produce 48, the latter alongside Yiren. Onda, on the other hand, was a contestant on Idol School, and E:U appeared on SBS' show Delicious Cooking Class, making Mia and Aisha the only members without a pre-debut appearance.

EVERGLOW received their first music show win with "Adios" on The Show on September 24th, 2019. They also won "Best Music Video Award" for their song "First" at the 2021 Asia Artist Awards, and "Post-Generation Award" at the 2023 Hanteo Music Awards.

Following the release of the group's third single album, Last Melody, the role of leader, initially held by E:U, was officially transferred to Sihyeon.

On May 13, 2025, it was reported that EVERGLOW would be leaving Yuehua Entertainment in June following the end of their contract. However, Sihyeon confirmed in a live that they wouldn't disband as the members still wants to be together and promote as a group.

On September 10, 2025 it was announced that EVERGLOW had signed an exclusive contract with CHXXTA Company. The group will continue as a quartet, as Mia decided to leave the group for personal reasons, while Yiren still has an active contract with Yuehua China.
